messages:
release-bot: Starting region-by-region rollout for release v2.9.1 -> US / EU / APAC
release-bot: Plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% per region, 30m observation windows, auto-fallback to v2.9.0 if errors > 1%
release-bot: Change window: 02:00-06:00 UTC (global), advised by product for low traffic

alex: Kicking off US canary now (us-east-1). Running quick capacity sweep on dedicated pools.
alex: Command: `./scripts/capacity-check --region us-east-1 --pool dedicated-1 --min-gpu 4`

priya: Got the sweep logs, 4 GPU nodes available, average token throughput looks normal. Latency p95 at 158ms for short prompts. :thumbsup:
jess: Observability dashboards green for US canary routes (no error spikes).

sam: EU scheduled to start at +45m, I'll prep a pin option. If EU latency > 250ms we should pin traffic to v2.9.0 there and continue US rollout.

nora: APAC has intermittent capacity pressure today, infra alerted: `queue_depth` elevated on apac-gpu-pool. Recommending reduced canary to 2% there.

alex: Noted. US canary -> increasing to 25% after checks pass. Proceeding.

release-bot: US canary -> 5% -> success. Moving to 25% in 10m.

priya: EU dry-run showed a config mismatch on kernel selection for quantized path on some nodes. It won't block canary but may cause higher CPU on host. Suggest pin fallback ready.

jess: Adding preemptive pin for EU: `pin: region=eu-west-1,version=v2.9.0` if errors >= 0.8% or p95 > 230ms for 15m.

nora: APAC reduced to 2% canary as requested. Also opened a temporary burst capacity request with infra.

infra-bot: burst request #BR-1029 submitted for apac-gpu-pool, ETA 22m. Currently 1.2x capacity available if approved.

sam: Quick decision: if APAC burst doesn't land within 30m, we'll pause APAC rollout and schedule a targeted rerun in next change window. Agreed? @nora @jess

nora: Agreed. We'll monitor.

alex: US at 25% now; metrics holding. No error rate increase. Ready to open to 100% in ~20m if stable.

release-bot: US -> 25% success. Next step scheduled: 100% in 20m unless rollup alerts fire.

priya: EU starting canary now (eu-west-1) at 5% with pin on standby.

jess: EU metrics: initial p95 212ms, error rate 0.3%. Watching for the kernel-induced CPU bump.

priya: CPU bump observed on 3 hosts after ~8m, p95 trending to 260ms but errors still low. Initiating canary throttles to cap at 10%.

jess: Activating pin to v2.9.0 for EU per rule; executing `release-bot pin eu-west-1 v2.9.0`

release-bot: Action taken: EU traffic pinned to v2.9.0. Canary for v2.9.1 in EU halted. Refer to rollback runbook #R-55 for postmortem checklist.

sam: Good call. We keep US full rollout going, EU will need a follow-up patch for kernel selection.

nora: APAC burst approved, but infra says it's slower to attach. Still expect >20m. Holding APAC at 2% until capacity confirmed.

alex: US continuing to 100% in 5m as agreed. 

release-bot: US rollout completed to 100% at 1799879943. No auto-fallbacks triggered.

priya: Filing release note: EU pinned back, APAC paused/burst pending. I'll add config diff & kernel trace to the ticket.

jess: Action items: (1) infra to reproduce kernel selection on smaller worker set, (2) runtime to add guard for quantized kernel mismatch, (3) product to update release notes about regional pin. Assigning in tracker.

infra-bot: Ticket created: INF-2347 reproducer for EU kernel selection.

sam: Final status update: US -> v2.9.1 fully rolled out. EU -> pinned to v2.9.0 (investigating). APAC -> paused at 2% pending burst attach, reschedule if not resolved in 6 hours.

nora: I'll send a brief note to customer-facing channels summarizing region status after we confirm APAC in 30m.

alex: Thanks team. Good coordination. :rocket:

release-bot: Thread closed for now. Use `release-bot reopen 1799876543` to add follow-ups.
